user.title: Danfoss Ally (Cloud)
user.description: Sign in with your Danfoss Ally / Smart Life app account. No developer app or API key is required. The installation secrets (sign key, device id, channel key) are captured once on the installation (see the documentation).

data.enable_local: Enable the local Zigbee tunnel (gateways) for writes the cloud misses
data.mqtt_mode: MQTT publishing: off, discovery (auto HA entities), zigbee2mqtt (z2m-compatible topics)
data.mqtt_source: Source of published values: cloud or local

get_rooms.name: List rooms
get_rooms.description: Rooms and the state of their heads.

get_local_survey.name: Local survey
get_local_survey.description: Read-only survey of every head through the local Zigbee tunnel (setpoints, schedule slots, attributes). Needs the local tunnel enabled.

set_descaling.name: Set valve descaling
set_descaling.description: Set the head's weekly valve-descaling day and time, over the local Zigbee tunnel (isolated heads of a verified product).

target.name: Head
target.description: Target head: type device and its device id (see the service example).

time.name: Time
time.description: Time of day (HH:MM) of the descaling cycle.

set_override.name: Set temperature override
set_override.description: One-off setpoint override on a head, over the local Zigbee tunnel. Lasts until the head's next scheduled change (not a durable setpoint).

target.name: Head
target.description: Target head: type device and its device id (see the service example).

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Override temperature in degrees C (5 to 35, by 0.5).

clear_override.name: Clear temperature override
clear_override.description: End an override by re-applying the setpoint the schedule prescribes now.

target.name: Head
target.description: Target head: type device and its device id (see the service example).

set_window_detection.name: Set window detection (local)
set_window_detection.description: Write a head's open-window detection over the local Zigbee tunnel (isolated heads of a verified product).

target.name: Head
target.description: Target head: type device and its device id (see the service example).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn open-window detection on or off.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Weekly schedule of a room or an isolated head.

target.name: Target
target.description: Target: type 'room' or 'device', and its id.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Re-read from the cloud instead of the cache.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Writes the given days of a target (validated first). Admin only.

target.name: Target
target.description: Target: type 'room' or 'device', and its id.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days to write: each day holds its ranges (start and end times).

copy_schedule.name: Copy schedule
copy_schedule.description: Copies one target's schedule onto others. Admin only.

restore_schedule.name: Restore schedule
restore_schedule.description: Rewrites the schedule then publishes at_home (R4). Admin only.

target.name: Target
target.description: Target: type 'room' or 'device', and its id.

get_write_job.name: Write job status
get_write_job.description: Follows a write job by its id.

get_room.name: Get room
get_room.description: One room's detail and its weekly schedule.

create_room.name: Create room
create_room.description: Create a room and attach the given heads. Admin; real-hardware validation required.

devices.name: Heads
devices.description: List of head devIds to attach (verified products).

delete_room.name: Delete room
delete_room.description: Delete a room; its heads become ungrouped. Admin; real-hardware validation required.

set_relay_room.name: Set relay room
set_relay_room.description: Link or unlink a room to the boiler relay (its heat demand drives the relay). Admin; real-hardware validation required.

linked.name: Linked
linked.description: On = the room drives the relay; off = unlink.

get_relays.name: Get boiler relays
get_relays.description: Boiler relays and the rooms driving them (read only).

get_overview.name: Get fleet overview
get_overview.description: Building / fleet overview across homes, gateways and rooms (read only).

attach_heads.name: Attach heads
attach_heads.description: Add heads to a room (replaces the member list). Admin.

detach_heads.name: Detach heads
detach_heads.description: Remove heads from a room (cannot empty it). Admin.

too_many_transitions.message: Too many ranges: at most three separate ranges (6 transitions) per day.

local_disabled.message: The local tunnel is not enabled on this account.

device_only.message: This local-tunnel action targets a head (type 'device').

unverified_product.message: Writing is not verified for this product.

local_unreachable.message: The head is not reachable through the local tunnel.

local_write_failed.message: The local-tunnel write was refused by the head.

invalid_day.message: Unknown day (expected mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat or sun).

invalid_setpoint.message: Setpoint out of range (5 to 35 degrees C, by 0.5).

no_schedule.message: No schedule to return to; the override lapses at the next scheduled change.

no_members_left.message: Detaching every head would empty the room: use delete_room.

unknown_home.message: None of the given heads were found in any home.

ambiguous_home.message: The given heads are in different homes; create one room per home.
